title: mavlink_telemetry_data_router0.10.0 ingestion (default compiled capacities)
$comment: Derived from sender/weather/spatial/telemetry/time_sync sources. Unknown object properties allowed. Arithmetic, cross-record consistency, dedup/upsert, physical accuracy and durability require application checks.

U64String.description: Canonical uint64 decimal string; parse losslessly.

U64Number.description: Existing numeric uint64 wire field: use a lossless JSON integer parser above2^53-1. Do not rewrite as a string.

Unit.description: General key/value display unit. unit_map does not convert values to SI.

Origin.description: Latitude deg, longitude deg, altitude MSL m; no geoid conversion.

anyOf.description: Frozen engineering clock diagnostics; no confidence interval or certified accuracy.

WeatherSample.description: Value units are temperature K or relative-humidity fraction, selected by enclosing metric. Null means unknown; velocity_valid requires acquisition-time evidence.

Weather.description: n0/empty groups is valid for spatial close-only updates. Total groups<=16 and total raw<=128 are application checks.

SpatialBin.description: Cumulative replacement revision; never sum repeated partial revisions.

Spatial.description: Nested weather field; not a top-level ingestion envelope. Default target10m, effective width can adapt. Horizontal speed-time path is an estimate.

WeatherEnvelope.description: Current sender emits one weather record per direct request. seq is numeric uint64; spatial revision is a string.

TelemetryRawRow.description: Fixed17 tuple matched by field_order. Both UTC columns null when UTC absent; known UTC has numeric uint32 uncertainty, possibly UINT32_MAX.

CsvV2.description: Explicit development CSV replay. Deduplicate stream/session/window_us; schema3 uses batch_id instead.

HeartbeatEnvelope.description: Diagnostic heartbeat/latest navigation, not a simultaneous atmospheric observation.

BundleEnvelope.description: Mixed live envelopes; spatial stays inside nested weather payloads.
